name: Square-based voxel rendering
definition: A rendering technique for small voxel sets that maps 3D voxels to 2D squares (tiles) on the screen to achieve real-time performance with visual compromises, avoiding the GPU load of dense polygon sets while maintaining voxel destructibility.
summary: Square-based voxel rendering maps 3D voxels to 2D squares for real-time performance, differing from sprite rendering by sacrificing volumetric depth for speed.
